target.definition: E[terminal win margin | o, a, p], margin = blue_score - red_score
target.orientation: blue is always the evaluated policy's team; positive = better for it

architecture.form: Q = b(o,p) + u(o,p)^T e(a1) + v(o,p)^T e(a2) + e(a1)^T M(o,p) e(a2)
architecture.M_factorisation: low-rank M = P Q^T, never materialised
architecture.per_agent_action: single categorical over 250 = 5 macros x 50 waypoints

training_config.loss: weighted MSE on terminal win margin

effective_sample_size.note: plain state rows share one episode label and are weighted 1/len(episode); they are not independent payoff observations

provenance.classification: REPLACEMENT EXECUTION after a post-fit diagnostic-path defect. NOT model selection, NOT bit-identical reproduction.

superseded_execution.why_not: qpsi_frozen.pt was deleted when clearing for the replacement run; those bytes no longer exist and therefore cannot be the authoritative frozen model

defect.what: the post-fit teacher-query diagnostic queried UNMASKED logits
defect.mechanism: load_custom_ppo_policy returns CustomPPOInferencePolicy, which exposes neither policy_logits nor _mask_logits; those live on the inner SharedActorCentralizedCritic. strategy_anchor._masked_heads therefore took its stub-friendly unmasked FALLBACK silently.
defect.detection: argmax of the queried distribution matched the recorded deterministic branch action on only 10-17% of states, where it must be ~1.0
defect.scope: POST-FIT DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Fitting regresses Q_psi on recorded (o, a, margin) and never queries a teacher distribution, so the fit itself was never affected.
defect.fix: unwrap to the inner model (the path the wrapper's own entropy() uses) and REFUSE rather than fall back; assert_teacher_query_valid() now gates every value computed from a teacher distribution

provenance.why_the_weights_differ_anyway: CUDA nondeterminism (cuDNN algorithm selection and atomic accumulation). Train loss at epoch 0 differs 0.83089 vs 0.83053. This is execution noise, not a configuration change.
explicitly_not: no hyperparameter was tuned between executions
no architecture was changed between executions
multiple valid scorers were NOT compared and the better-ordering one chosen
